subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require default confirmation, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out or step-count config for that behavior?
rationale: The implementation shape is bounded, but it changes documented command semantics and may add public config, so repository policy requires maintainer intent before automation should proceed.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and defer config until follow-up evidence proves power-user need.

options.title: Add configurable confirmation
options.body: Add confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the config/schema/docs burden.

options.title: Preserve explicit command behavior
options.body: Keep typed commands immediate and limit confirmation to visible UI affordances or future non-command controls.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` exempt, and defer config until follow-up evidence proves power-user need.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the existing Control UI confirmation guard and the intentional preservation of typed command behavior in the merged adjacent PR.
